verses.1: And after that, David defeated the Philistines. He captured their idols from them. David took the idols of the Philistines as spoils.
verses.2: And he tied Moab to the cord of death. He ordered that two ropes be used to kill them. The rope was meant to bring about their death. Moab became servants and slaves to David.
verses.3: And David took Hadorazzer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as his companion on his journey to recover his hand in the river Porth.
verses.4: David gathered from him eight hundred and seventy chariots, and forty thousand men. David destroyed all the chariots. He kept only one hundred chariots for himself.
verses.5: And Aram Damshok came to help King Zobah. David had twenty thousand men in Aram.
verses.6: And David set up tabernacles in the wilderness of Paran. And Paran became a place for David to serve as a place of worship. And Jehovah saved David from all his troubles.
verses.7: And David took the golden shields that belonged to the servants of Hadadezer, and he brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.8: And from Betah and from Beryoth, the cities of Hadadzer were taken by King David. He took many of them.
verses.9: And Toi, king of Hamath, heard that David had defeated all the armies of Hadadezer.
verses.10: And Toi sent Yoram’s son to King David, asking him to bless him and give him encouragement, because Yoram was one of Toi’s warriors. In his hands he had all kinds of gold, silver, and jewels.
verses.11: King David also sanctified them for Jehovah, along with the gold and silver that he had gathered from all the nations.
verses.12: From Aram, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from Philistines, and from Edom, and from Shelah-hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.13: And David built a city there from the ruins of the city of Ai, on the mountain of Gilboa. It was built over twelve thousand years ago.
verses.14: And Adam placed statutes in every place where he set his feet. Thus, every person became David’s servant. And Jehovah saved David from all those who opposed him.
verses.15: David ruled over all of Israel. He carried out justice and righteousness for every nation.
verses.16: And Joab, son of Zeruiah, will lead the army. And Yehoshafat, son of Ahilud, will be their judge.
verses.17: And Zadok, son of Achitub, and Ahimelech, son of Abiathar, were priests and singers.
verses.18: And his sons, Yehoyada’s sons, I recognized them. I also appointed them as priests. And David’s sons were also priests.
